The triple intersection equals q+1+q e_1(C)-e(C), derived from two linear equations for each rank-one image line using the matrix determinant lemma. Inclusion-exclusion yields the exact formula. Standard GL2 rational-canonical centralizers prove the exhaustive table; all multiplicities sum to |GL2(q)|. Direct exhaustive computations over F2,F3,F4,F5 reproduce every stratum. Finite tests are only checks, not the universal proof.

Uniformly classifying every relative automorphism in rank two by seven canonical types, with exact frequencies, sharp q>=3 existence counts and the small-field obstruction, is a motivated complete classification, not a routine substitution or isolated finite table.
